title: src/definition/rollback.zig supersede UPDATE compares def_id = $3::uuid but promotion_reviews.def_id is TEXT -> sqlstate 42883 (operator does not exist); swallowed by catch null so superseded_review_id is always null (PRM-08 AC4 never works)

incidental_of.context: PRODUCTION defect in src/definition/rollback.zig Step 5 supersede. Distinct from and in addition to ISS-0711/GH-802 (test fixture 23502). Filed per No-Issue-Left-Local-Only. Blocks the GH-802 acceptance criterion 'zig build test-integration-prm08 passes' because TC-PRM-08-03's superseded_review_id path can never succeed while this defect is present.

scope: Production defect in src/definition/rollback.zig Step 5 only. The supersede UPDATE compares promotion_reviews.def_id (TEXT, migration 096) against $3::uuid, which PostgreSQL rejects with sqlstate 42883 'operator does not exist: text = uuid'. The queryRow is wrapped in `catch null` (comment 'table may not exist (PRM-04 is a later batch)'), so the 42883 is silently swallowed and superseded_review_id is ALWAYS null in every environment where the promotion_reviews table exists. PRM-08 AC4 (superseded_review_id populated) therefore never works. No test file and no migration is implicated.
description: src/definition/rollback.zig Step 5 runs: UPDATE promotion_reviews SET status = 'superseded', superseded_by = $1::uuid WHERE tenant_id = $2::uuid AND def_id = $3::uuid AND status IN ('applied', 'approved') RETURNING id::text, with params [event_id, tenant_id, current_active_id]. Migration 096 defines def_id as text NOT NULL (not uuid). Comparing text = uuid has no implicit operator, so PostgreSQL raises sqlstate 42883 'operator does not exist: text = uuid' at execution time. The queryRow is wrapped in `catch null`, so the error is treated as 'table may not exist' and swallowed: superseded_review_id stays null and the promotion_reviews row is never superseded. This means PRM-08 AC4 (rollback supersedes the matching promotion_reviews row) is functionally broken in production whenever the table exists. Empirically reproduced in the WF03-GH802 step-1 diagnosis run: zig build test-integration-prm08 (BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test) trace shows sqlstate=42883 params=3 sql=UPDATE promotion_reviews SET status = 'superseded' ... before the fixture INSERT 23502.
symptom: PRM-08 rollback never supersedes a matching promotion_reviews row: superseded_review_id in RollbackResult is always null even when a matching 'applied'/'approved' review row exists. In the prm-08 integration run the failure surfaces as a swallowed sqlstate 42883 ('operator does not exist: text = uuid') on the Step 5 supersede UPDATE; it is invisible to callers because of the `catch null` guard, which was written to tolerate a missing table, not a type-mismatched query.
root_cause: Type mismatch between the supersede predicate and the schema: rollback.zig Step 5 casts the bound def id as ::uuid and compares it to promotion_reviews.def_id, which migration 096 declares as TEXT. No implicit text = uuid operator exists, so the statement raises 42883 at execution time. The `catch null` wrapper (added to tolerate the table not existing when PRM-04 is a later batch) conflates 'table missing' with 'query failed' and swallows the real error, masking the defect in every passing test and in production.

(the Step 5 supersede from rollback.zig). (2) Static trace — src/definition/rollback.zig lines 286-298: WHERE tenant_id = $2::uuid AND def_id = $3::uuid AND status IN ('applied','approved') RETURNING id::text, params [event_id, tenant_id, current_active_id]; current_active_id is a uuid string bound as text. (3) migrations/096_promotion_reviews.sql: def_id text NOT NULL confirmed (also requested_by uuid NOT NULL, def_type text NOT NULL, serialised_plan text NOT NULL). (4) fn:search-issues over docs/issues/ + gh issue list --search 'rollback supersede def_id 42883' / 'superseded_review_id' / 'prm-08' --state all: no existing ISS or GitHub issue covers this production supersede defect (ISS-0702/GH-780 covers zig 0.16 compile errors only; ISS-0711/GH-802 covers the test-fixture 23502 only). New issue.
reproduction: BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test zig build test-integration-prm08 with the promotion_reviews table present (clean_test_db applies migration 096 to tenant_default). Any TC-PRM-08-01/02/03 rollback that reaches Step 5 executes the supersede UPDATE; the statement raises sqlstate 42883 (swallowed by catch null), and superseded_review_id is null. With -Dlog-pg-errors=true the raw server error 'operator does not exist: text = uuid' is visible.
fix_diff: Drop the ::uuid cast on the bound def id so the predicate matches the TEXT column: change `AND def_id = $3::uuid` to `AND def_id = $3` (current_active_id is already a uuid string bound as text; with no cast PostgreSQL infers text = text). Do NOT wrap real query errors in the same catch-null as a missing table — consider distinguishing 'relation does not exist' (SQLSTATE 42P01) from other errors so genuine failures surface instead of being silently treated as 'table may not exist'.

actions: SQL predicates must be type-checked against the actual column types in the applied migrations; casting a bound parameter to a type that differs from the column type (here ::uuid vs TEXT def_id) is a compile-time-invisible runtime error that only surfaces at execution.
Do not use a broad `catch null` to tolerate a missing table — check the specific SQLSTATE (42P01 relation does not exist) so a missing table is skipped but any other query error propagates.

The lint_sql_param_types.py / lint_sql_table_refs.py linters already catch C42883 patterns elsewhere (see ISS-0124, ISS-0637/0638, ISS-0632); extend or run them over src/definition/rollback.zig so this class is caught statically next time.

When a query binds a value into a column, the parameter type must match the column type — TEXT columns must not be compared with ::uuid-cast parameters; a bare `catch null` must never swallow real query errors — distinguish SQLSTATE 42P01 from other failures.

resolution: RESOLVED via run WF03-GH803-20260816 (branch feature/WF03-GH803-20260816). The production supersede defect in src/definition/rollback.zig Step 5 was fixed (production change, per src/design/iss0712-gh803-rollback-supersede-fix.md). Step 1 (ISSUE-FIXER) confirmed the 42883 diagnosis against the actual code: the supersede UPDATE compared promotion_reviews.def_id (TEXT, migration 096) against $3::uuid (no implicit text = uuid operator -> sqlstate 42883), and the bare `catch null` wrapper swallowed the error so superseded_review_id was always null (PRM-08 AC4 never worked). Step 3 (BACKEND-DEV) implemented the two-part fix in src/definition/rollback.zig ONLY: Change A — line 290 `AND def_id = $3::uuid` -> `AND def_id = $3` (drop the ::uuid cast so the TEXT column compares text = text; $1::uuid/$2::uuid unchanged); Change B — line 295 bare `catch null` replaced with a SQLSTATE-distinguishing catch mirroring the PAR-01 pattern in src/event_store/store.zig (copy conn.lastSqlState() into a 5-byte buffer; 42P01 -> null for a genuinely missing table, else switch PoolError.ExhaustedPool -> RollbackError.PoolExhausted / else -> RollbackError.TransactionFailed) so real query failures surface as RollbackError. No migration needed (schema is correct; the bug was the query cast).
